source_corrections.evidence: the following definition confirms the intended neighborhood relation
source_corrections.source_issue: the source omits the articles in the phrase to be neighborhood of point a
source_corrections.target_action: translate the intended relation naturally as a neighborhood of point a

source_corrections.evidence: O is assumed to be a union of open balls so x belongs to a constituent ball contained in O
source_corrections.source_issue: the informal phrase an open ball B in O that contains x can be misread as elementhood of B in O
source_corrections.target_action: state explicitly that B is contained in O and contains x

source_corrections.evidence: the definition gives Int(A) as a subset of A and the immediately following theorem states the correct largest-open-subset characterization
source_corrections.source_issue: the paragraph calls Int(A) the largest open subset of X that contains A and thereby reverses the required inclusion
source_corrections.target_action: state that Int(A) is the largest open subset of X contained in A

source_corrections.evidence: S is the only finite point set declared in the exercise and its complement is the intended object
source_corrections.source_issue: the exercise declares the finite point set S but asks about the complement of undefined A
source_corrections.target_action: replace R squared setminus A with R squared setminus S

source_corrections.evidence: the repaired grammar preserves the stated continuity question without choosing a theorem target
source_corrections.source_issue: the phrase if f a continuous function omits is
source_corrections.target_action: translate the question with the complete predicate f merupakan fungsi kontinu

source_corrections.evidence: both the open-set continuity theorem and the open-ball corollary are nearby applicable results so the target is not unambiguous
source_corrections.source_issue: the instruction Use Theorem supplies neither an xref nor a theorem identifier
source_corrections.target_action: preserve the generic theorem wording and do not attach an xref until the intended target is established authoritatively

source_corrections.evidence: for b nonzero the map does not send zero to zero and therefore is not linear
source_corrections.source_issue: the source calls f(x)=ax+b an arbitrary linear function although arbitrary b makes it affine and it is linear only when b=0
source_corrections.target_action: preserve the formula and quantified scope in translation and flag the classification for authoritative correction

source_corrections.evidence: the interrogative syntax and surrounding activity prompt order make the intended punctuation certain
source_corrections.source_issue: two direct questions end with periods
source_corrections.target_action: translate the questions with question marks

source_corrections.evidence: the prose repairs do not change mathematical content or XML topology
source_corrections.source_issue: the collection form has subject-verb disagreement and Then interior of A omits the article
source_corrections.target_action: translate both statements with natural Indonesian agreement and grammar
